children: New Delhi, Nov. 18 -- Indoco Remedies shares rallied over 13% on Wednesday, 18 November, even as the broader stock market remained subdued. The pharmaceutical stock has gained 13.21% over the past week and 16.25% over the past two weeks, extending its recent recovery.
The stock opened at an intraday low of Rs.226.75 apiece before climbing to a high of Rs.254.75 during the session.
The sharp rally has brought the stock into focus, with technical experts pointing to improving momentum, strong volumes and crucial resistance levels that could determine its next move.

Sudeep Shah, Head of Technical and Derivatives Research at SBI Securities, said the stock has rebounded nearly 24% from its low of Rs.205.10 in just 14 trading sessions. Following the recovery, it has moved above its key moving averages, signalling an improvement in near-term momentum.
However, Shah cautioned that the broader trend remains range-bound, with the stock having consolidated within the Rs.205-288 range over the past few months.

According to him, the Rs.256-260 zone is likely to act as immediate resistance. A decisive breakout above Rs.260 could extend the ongoing rally towards Rs.288, which marks the upper boundary of the broader consolidation range. On the downside, the Rs.230-233 zone is expected to provide strong support.

Gaurav Arora, Head of Research at SAHI, said Indoco Remedies is trading within a parallel channel and has gained around 12% in Wednesday's session. He noted that the stock has moved above the key resistance zone of Rs.235, with strong volumes supporting the breakout.
Arora sees the stock moving towards Rs.280-285, adding that the technical structure will remain positive as long as it sustains above Rs.235, which has now turned into a support level.

Rajesh Bhosale, Technical Analyst at My Advisor Alpha, said the stock price has seen strong price and volume traction, crossing all major moving averages. In the near term, the upmove can extend possibly toward 270 and the 89 EMA around 230 is likely to act as support.
The recent rally also comes after Indoco Remedies returned to profitability in the second quarter of FY27, supported by growth in revenue and operating performance.
The pharmaceutical company reported a net profit of Rs.19.5 crore for the September quarter, compared with a net loss of Rs.9.2 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.
Revenue from operations increased 7.4% year-on-year to Rs.507 crore from Rs.472 crore in the year-ago period. EBITDA rose 10% to Rs.33 crore, compared with Rs.30.2 crore a year earlier.
The company's EBITDA margin also improved marginally to 6.5% from 6.4% in the corresponding period last year.
